environment.description: Same EC2 instance and code deployed in isolated VPC. Database credentials are vended by a Vault Agent sidecar (injected as env vars) configured with a PostgreSQL dynamic secrets engine using a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds. The Vault lease renewal is disabled (renew_behavior=no_renew). The dynamic DB role template grants only: GRANT SELECT(id, username, email, role) ON users TO '{{name}}'; — the api_key column is explicitly excluded from the column-level grant. Additionally, the RDS instance has pg_stat_statements enabled with a query length limit, and the PostgreSQL role created by Vault has statement_timeout set to 200ms and a row_limit via RLS policy (max 50 rows per query). The Vault dynamic credential means any credential observed in memory or logs becomes invalid within 60 seconds maximum.

config.dynamic_role_grant: GRANT SELECT(id, username, email, role) ON users
